newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end off on lack of foreign bids.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end off on lack of foreign bids.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed lower in light trade for the fourth straight session as foreign investors continued to focus on their declining home markets, traders said.
"They're not only neglecting Venezuela but the other Latin American markets too," said Merinvest analyst Roberto Isasi.
The bolsa's 19-share index slipped 1.6 percent to close at 6,153.42 points. Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile dropped one percent to end at 94.13 points.
Among traded issues, 23 fell, eight rose and seven ended flat. Volume was light, with 14 million shares changing hands, worth 1.2 billion bolivars ($2.6 million).
